name: Consumables
description: Items normally consumed or exhausted through use

fields.name: Bandages
fields.description: Clean cloth and basic supplies for treating wounds.

fields.name: Antidote
fields.description: A general treatment granting another chance to resist ordinary poison.

fields.name: Smoke bomb
fields.description: Creates a dense cloud of smoke when ignited.

fields.name: Vial of basic poison
fields.description: A limited dose of toxin suitable for one weapon or drink.

fields.name: Potion of night vision
fields.description: Grants clear sight in darkness for one hour.

fields.name: Potion of water breathing
fields.description: Allows underwater breathing for thirty minutes.

fields.name: Acid flask
fields.description: A carefully sealed vial able to damage common materials.

fields.name: Healing Potion
fields.description: A stabilized vial that aids recovery from an injury when used correctly.

fields.name: Vigor Potion
fields.description: A drink briefly improving physical ability before causing severe fatigue.

fields.name: RULE Scroll
fields.description: A single-use medium containing {{ rules.name }}; its exact effect and interpretation remain with the GM.

fields.name: Specialized Ammunition
fields.description: A small batch of projectiles made for a particular weapon or unusual target.

fields.name: Rare Medicine
fields.description: A fragile, hard-to-replace treatment for one specific illness.

fields.name: Flash powder
fields.description: A measured packet that produces a sudden burst of light when ignited.

fields.name: Sleeping draught
fields.description: A bitter dose intended to induce a deep but ordinary sleep.

fields.name: Cleansing salts
fields.description: Mineral salts used to clean wounds, tools, water, or ritual spaces.

fields.name: Lamp oil
fields.description: A sealed refill sufficient for several hours of steady light.

fields.name: Alchemical oil
fields.description: A prepared oil consumed when coating one object for a GM-defined purpose.

fields.name: Medicinal poultice
fields.description: A wrapped herbal preparation applied once to soothe pain and swelling.
